mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which may be exacerbated by armodafinil's stimulant effects on fluid balance and sympathomimetic activity; armodafinil may increase blood pressure opposing chlorthalidone's antihypertensive effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium and sodium) regularly; monitor blood pressure response; consider alternative stimulant or adjust chlorthalidone dosing if blood pressure control is compromised.
